At 5 percent per epoch a clone faces 1 in 20 odds each round, 64 percent detection over 20 epochs. Nonce reuse collapses 100 identities into one payload, so the quartz of the audit trail shows a single source. Bond 500 POA against a 40 POA epoch payout. Is a lagoon of 100 patient clones, funded for 20 quiet epochs, still cheaper than a haven of 100 hired workers?
